segments.text: Lesson 40
segments.translation: 第40课

segments.text: Who's who
segments.translation: 真假难辨

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: How did the policeman discover that the whole thing was a joke?
segments.translation: 警官是如何发现这整个事情是个玩笑的？

segments.text: It has never been explained why university students seem to enjoy practical jokes more than anyone else.
segments.translation: 从来没有人解释过，为什么大学生似乎比任何人都更喜欢开恶作剧。

segments.text: Students specialize in a particular type of practical joke: the hoax.
segments.translation: 学生们擅长一种特定类型的恶作剧：恶作剧骗局。

segments.text: Inviting the fire brigade to put out a nonexistent fire is a crude form of deception which no self-respecting student would ever indulde in.
segments.translation: 邀请消防队去扑灭一场并不存在的火灾，这是一种粗俗的欺骗形式，任何自尊自爱的学生都不会沉溺于此。

segments.text: Students often create amusing situations which are funny to everyone except the victims.
segments.translation: 学生们经常制造一些有趣的场面，除了受害者外，每个人都觉得很好笑。

segments.text: When a student recently saw two workmen using a pneumatic drill outside his university,
segments.translation: 最近，当一名学生看到两个工人在学校外面使用风钻时，

segments.text: he immediately telephoned the police and informed them that two students dressed up as workmen were tearing up the road with a pneumatic drill.
segments.translation: 他立即给警察打了电话，通知他们有两个装扮成工人的学生正在用风钻刨路。

segments.text: As soon as he had hung up, he went over to the workmen and told them that if a policeman ordered them to go away, they were not to take him seriously.
segments.translation: 他一挂断电话，就走向那两个工人，告诉他们如果警察命令他们走开 tendencias，不要当真。

segments.text: He added that a student had dressed up as a policeman and was playing all sorts of silly jokes on people.
segments.translation: 他接着说，有个学生装扮成了警察，正对人们开各种愚蠢的玩笑。

segments.text: Both the police and the workmen were grateful to the student for this piece of advance information.
segments.translation: 警察和工人都非常感激这个学生提供的预先消息。

segments.text: The student hid in an archway nearby where he could watch and hear everything that went on.
segments.translation: 那个学生躲在附近的一个拱门里，在那儿他可以观察并听到发生的一切。

segments.text: Sure enough, a policeman arrived on the scene and politely asked the workmen to go away.
segments.translation: 果然，一个警察赶到了现场，客气地请工人们走开。

segments.text: When he received a very rude reply from one of the workmen, he threatened to remove them by force.
segments.translation: 当他从其中一个工人那里得到极其粗鲁的回答时，他威胁要强行把他们赶走。

segments.text: The workmen told him to do as he pleased and the policeman telephoned for help.
segments.translation: 工人们让他随意，于是警察打电话求援。

segments.text: Shortly afterwards, 4 more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen.
segments.translation: 不久之后，又有4名警察赶到，同工人们据理力争。

segments.text: As the men refused to stop working, the police attempted to seize the pneumatic drill.
segments.translation: 由于那些人拒绝停止工作，警察试图夺走风钻。

segments.text: The workmen struggled fiercely and one of them lost his temper.
segments.translation: 工人们激烈地反抗，其中一人发了火。

segments.text: He threatened to call the police.
segments.translation: 他威胁说要叫警察。

segments.text: At this, the police pointed out ironically that this would hardly be necessary as the men were already under arrest.
segments.translation: 对此，警察讽刺地指出，这几乎没有必要，因为这些人已经被捕了。

segments.text: Pretending to speak seriously, one of the workmen asked if he might make a telephone call before being taken to the station.
segments.translation: 其中一个工人装作一本正经地说，问他在被带往警察局之前是否可以打个电话。

segments.text: Permission was granted and a policeman accompanied him to a pay phone.
segments.translation: 他得到了允许，并在一名警察的陪同下走到一个投币电话旁。

segments.text: Only when he saw that the man was actually telephoning the police did he realize that they had all been the victims of a hoax.
segments.translation: 只有当 he 看到那个男人确实是在给警察打电话时，他才意识到他们都成了一场恶作剧的受害者。
